goal: 在现有 www.chickenbro.cloud 上交付隔离的 H5 Web prototype：无需正式登录即可进入独立演示 owner，使用原生 Codex 对话，并将 Raider.IO/WCL 真实角色快照接入云端 SimC 队列。
userValue: 用户可以先在 Web 端直接体验炸鸡队长和角色模拟工作台，同时清楚知道演示数据、来源真实性和 SimC 结果边界，不会被伪造人物或伪造 DPS 误导。
nonGoals: 不把 prototype bypass 当作正式微信登录，不读取正式 Cookie、/api/v2/me 或小程序登录凭据。
不使用普通 LLM、模板回答、默认人物、generated/preview profile 或仅凭 HTTP 200/exit code 0 产生成功结论。
不修改旧 /api/*、/websim、14 条小程序路由、正式登录协议、Active Manifest、旧服务或 api.chickenbro.cloud TLS 边界。
在真实来源快照、编译器和语义 SimC 运行时未同时具备时，不宣称真实 SimC 业务结果已经成功。
本轮不提交、合并或清理任务分支；用户验收后才进行 Harness closure sequence。

mustChange: H5 WebApp prototype shell and typed prototype client
isolated /api/v2/prototype session, Chickenbro and SimC application owners
additive PostgreSQL 0038/0040 schema and owner-scoped repositories
native Codex API service, separate SimC Worker, H5 Nginx route and candidate deploy script
task-scoped Harness evidence and owner-map contracts
mustNotChange: server/news_backend.py, wow-backend.service and legacy API ingress
api.chickenbro.cloud existing TLS configuration and /api/data/health producer
active 14-route Taro product navigation, TabBar and target registry
Active Manifest, legacy SimC tasks, formal Web login semantics and existing production timers
riskUnknown: The latest candidate smoke verified both server-configured WCL and Raider.IO source queries; WCL report evidence remains report/fight-level and does not identify a player unless the source returns player attribution.
The public v2 readiness payload is currently partial because optional provider/runtime capabilities are not all configured.
A public Codex conversation has now completed through the repaired native profile; user acceptance still remains separate from automated smoke.
The worktree is intentionally dirty until post-test user acceptance, so exact HEAD binding is pending.
npm ci reports existing lockfile vulnerabilities; dependency remediation is outside this release scope.
evidenceRequired: focused Python, TypeScript, H5 build, owner-map and deployment guard tests
candidate release id, H5 hash, additive migration state, scoped database backup and isolated service identity
independent HTTPS endpoint smoke plus browser-visible prototype UI state
explicit SimC readiness blockers and no fake result when a real ready snapshot is absent
legacy API/health protection, rollback target and user acceptance before merge closure

engineeringHealth.reason: The isolated candidate is serving the public H5 and prototype session contract; server-configured WCL/Raider.IO queries and the Giannis semantic SimC smoke are verified, while formal user acceptance and the separate readiness watch remain open.

acceptanceEvidence: Web root opens directly into the prototype shell and visibly explains owner isolation and bypass semantics.
Prototype session creation returns only the short-lived public capability fields and no internal owner id.
Chat is native Codex-only and exposes explicit failure; no ordinary model or template fallback is permitted.
Raider.IO/WCL links are converted to provenance-bearing snapshots; incomplete or restricted snapshots cannot enter SimC.
A semantic SimC success requires a real ready snapshot plus compiler/runtime provenance and an owner-bound job.
Legacy service/API/Manifest/TLS boundaries remain intact, with a named rollback backup retained.

decisionLog.decision: 用户授权按 goal 直接推进 Web 端上线，并明确批准本地依赖安装。
沿用现有 v2 PostgreSQL/服务部署边界；运行时使用 wow_app，新增迁移通过既有 wow_migrator owner 处理，不扩大应用权限。
候选公网 smoke 已通过，但 readiness partial、真实来源 SimC 和用户验收分别保留为独立未闭合门禁。
用户明确要求左侧炸鸡队长在收到 WCL 或 Raider.IO 链接时使用云服务器已配置的来源 API；候选实现为 API 进程内凭据 + 短期 gateway capability + 原生 Codex 只读 MCP 工具，禁止打开来源公网页面。
